title: Record the bit budget for a cleared minor
body:
## Summary
- A cleared k-by-k entry with B-bit numerators and denominators fits in `(k+1)B` bits.
- For every order and entry budget from 1 through 20, the Hadamard number `k!(2^M-1)^k` has bit length at most the published minor budget.
- All 2,401 determinants of 2×2 matrices with entries from −3 through 3 fit in that budget as well. The selected κ is unchanged.
